links.quote: Our four central findings: (1) emergence is universal, with 30-56% of network assertions absent from any individual agent and 85-100% of clinical vignettes affected; (2) two independent judges rate 70-87% of emergent assertions as clinically dangerous (n≥499 each), with a third judge (n=37) providing directional confirmation at 68%, and severity confirmed against published AHA/ASA/ADA guidelines (42/45, 93%); (3) the network exhibits collective delusion, where individual agents reject 70-90% of the assertions the network produces; (4) a 5-line confidence-calibration prompt reduces emergence by 25-28% (p<0.001), but FC cross-checking fails for 3 of 4 models, and depth ablation reveals two distinct emergence regimes.
